ERR-2026-06-14-001.title: Stalled Release Promotion due to missing SOURCE_COMMIT metadata
ERR-2026-06-14-001.description:
The self-evolving loop went idle, and subagents stopped receiving tasks.
The coordinator was permanently blocked at the promotion stage in the
health check service, outputting 'blocked_not_ready' status.
ERR-2026-06-14-001.root_cause:
The coordinator's promotion module checks for a 'SOURCE_COMMIT' file in the
active production release directory to establish the base git hash of the running system.
During deployment or manual release creation, this file was missing, halting the pipeline.
ERR-2026-06-14-001.impact: The autonomous evolution loop stopped entirely for multiple hours until manual intervention.
ERR-2026-06-14-001.fix_applied:
1. Located active release commit hash via git log.
2. Manually wrote the hash to the 'SOURCE_COMMIT' file inside the active release folder.
3. Restarted the health service to trigger verification.
ERR-2026-06-14-001.prevention: Every release packaging or manual hotfix script must write and preserve the 'SOURCE_COMMIT' file in the release directory root.

ERR-2026-06-15-004.title: Direct SCP Permission Denied on opencode-owned subagent repository files
ERR-2026-06-15-004.description: Attempting to copy code files directly from the subagent research workspace /home/opencode/servers_team/repo_research/ via scp failed with Permission Denied or No such file or directory.
ERR-2026-06-15-004.root_cause: The files inside the subagent repository are owned by the system user 'opencode' and group-writeable, but the ssh session runs under user 'ozand', which does not have read permissions to parts of the home directory structure of 'opencode'.
ERR-2026-06-15-004.impact: Unable to directly pull down agent improvements or logs from the host workspace, slowing down verification and porting of fixes.
ERR-2026-06-15-004.fix_applied:
Used ssh command substitution with sudo to read files:
ssh eeepc "sudo -u opencode cat /path/to/file" > local_file
ERR-2026-06-15-004.prevention: Always access research repository files on the host using 'sudo -u opencode' commands instead of direct scp under normal user accounts.
